interpretation: G1 reproduces the full-reference low-fraction f3-to-f4 response slope extremely closely in TT, EE and TE, while its f2-to-f3 slope is much steeper than full cl_ref.pre. This localizes the residual mismatch of G1 as a high-fraction/endpoint response distortion rather than a failure of the recovered low-fraction law. The comparison is descriptive and does not create a new pass/fail metric or alter the frozen parent-group classification.
